selection: Maximize target development balanced accuracy; break ties toward the smallest nonnegative strength. Never select on test results.
random_control_strength: Selected strength, including zero if development selects no edit.
bootstrap: Paired noun clusters, stratified by gender, retaining both frames; percentile interval is descriptive, not an equivalence test.
competence_rule: Baseline source and target accuracy must each be at least 75% in both genders on held-out nouns. This is a diagnostic operational threshold, not proof of general competence.
support_rule: Selected edit must improve held-out accuracy, have paired gain CI lower bound above zero, beat calibration and the random-control 95th percentile, pass the regression threshold, and pass the competence gate. A failed rule leaves the broader transfer hypothesis unresolved.
status: Follow-up designed after inspecting the original experiment. A local pre-evaluation fingerprint is not independently registered. Synthetic Swedish contexts have not received independent speaker validation.
